name: local_run_command
description: Run any shell command on the local machine. Use for npm, git, prisma, build scripts, terminal operations, or any command-line task.

name: local_run_script
description: Run a script file on the local machine — Node.js, Python, bash, or any interpreter. Auto-detects interpreter from file extension.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the script

name: local_read_file
description: Read the full contents of any file on the local machine. Detects binary files and optionally limits output to a max number of lines.

path.description: File path (relative to WORKSPACE_ROOT or absolute)

max_lines.description: Only return the first N lines

name: local_read_multiple_files
description: Read several files at once and return all their contents in a single response. Useful for comparing or reviewing related files.

paths.description: Array of file paths to read

name: local_read_json
description: Read and parse a JSON file, returning the parsed data object directly — no need to parse the string yourself.

name: local_read_csv
description: Read a CSV file and return rows as an array of objects with column headers as keys.

name: local_get_file_info
description: Get detailed metadata for a file or directory: size, type, creation/modification/access dates, line count, and binary detection.

name: local_get_file_hash
description: Calculate the cryptographic hash (SHA256, MD5, SHA1) of a file for integrity checking or deduplication.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm: sha256, md5, sha1 (default sha256)

name: local_count_lines
description: Count lines, words, and characters in a file. Also reports blank line count.

name: local_compare_files
description: Show the diff between two files with configurable context lines. Returns whether they are identical.

name: local_write_file
description: Write or overwrite a file on the local machine. Creates parent directories automatically.

create_dirs.description: Create parent directories if needed (default true)

name: local_append_file
description: Append content to the end of an existing file (or create it if it does not exist).

name: local_write_json
description: Write a JavaScript object to a JSON file with pretty-printing and configurable indentation.

data.description: Object or array to write as JSON

name: local_replace_in_file
description: Find-and-replace text within a single file. Supports plain text or regex patterns.

regex.description: Treat find as a regex pattern

name: local_delete_file
description: Delete a file from the local machine. Throws if the file does not exist.

name: local_copy_file
description: Copy a file to a new location. Optionally overwrite if destination already exists.

overwrite.description: Overwrite destination if it exists (default false)

name: local_move_file
description: Move or rename a file or directory to a new path.

name: local_list_directory
description: List files and folders in a directory on the local machine. Supports recursive listing, hidden files, and extension filtering.

filter_ext.description: Only show files with this extension (e.g. .ts)

name: local_make_directory
description: Create a directory or nested directories on the local machine (equivalent to mkdir -p).

name: local_create_directory
description: Create a directory or nested directories (alias for local_make_directory).

name: local_delete_directory
description: Recursively delete a directory and all its contents (rm -rf equivalent). Use dry_run to preview what would be deleted.

dry_run.description: Preview deletion without actually deleting (default false)

name: local_copy_directory
description: Copy an entire directory and all its contents to a new location recursively.

name: local_get_directory_size
description: Get the total disk size of a directory and all its contents, plus file count.

name: local_count_files
description: Count files in a directory grouped by extension — useful for understanding a project's language breakdown.

name: local_list_files_by_size
description: List files in a directory sorted by size (largest first) — useful for finding what's taking up disk space.

name: local_list_files_by_date
description: List files in a directory sorted by modification date (newest first).

name: local_find_files
description: Search for files by filename pattern or content. Returns file paths and matching lines when content_search is provided.

pattern.description: Filename or path pattern to match

content_search.description: Search for this text within file contents

name: local_search_files
description: Search for files by filename pattern or content (alias for local_find_files).

contains.description: Search for this text within file contents

name: local_read_env_file
description: List all variable keys in a .env file with values masked for security. Use local_get_env to read a specific key's value.

name: local_get_env
description: Read the value of a specific key from a .env file. Returns the actual unmasked value.

name: local_update_env_var
description: Set or update a specific key in a .env file. Creates the key if it does not exist.

name: local_set_env
description: Set or update a key in a .env file (alias for local_update_env_var).

name: local_get_system_info
description: Get system information: Node.js version, npm, git, platform, architecture, disk usage, and workspace root.

name: local_get_disk_usage
description: Show disk usage statistics for all mounted filesystems.

name: local_check_port
description: Check whether a specific TCP port is currently in use on the local machine.

name: local_get_processes
description: List running processes on the local machine, optionally filtered by process name.

name: local_open_url
description: Open a URL in the default browser on the local machine (uses xdg-open on Linux or cmd.exe start on Windows).

name: local_find_and_replace
description: Find-and-replace text across multiple files in a directory, filtered by file extension. Supports dry_run to preview.

name: local_git_status
description: Get the git status of a repository — shows branch, changed files, staged files, and recent commits.

name: local_git_log
description: Get the commit history for a git repository with optional filtering by author, date, or branch.

name: local_git_diff
description: Show the current unstaged or staged diff for a git repository. Optionally diff a specific file.

staged.description: Show staged diff instead of unstaged (default false)

file.description: Limit diff to a specific file

name: local_git_add
description: Stage files for commit (git add). Stage all changes or specific files.

files.description: Specific files to stage (omit to stage all)

all.description: Stage all changes including deletions (git add -A)

name: local_git_commit
description: Create a git commit with a message. Commits whatever is currently staged.

name: local_git_push
description: Push commits to a remote git repository. Optionally force push or set upstream tracking.

name: local_git_pull
description: Pull latest changes from a remote git repository. Optionally rebase instead of merge.

name: local_git_checkout
description: Checkout a branch or restore a specific file from git history.

target.description: Branch name or commit hash to checkout

file.description: Restore a specific file (use with target commit)

name: local_git_create_branch
description: Create a new git branch, optionally from a specific ref, and check it out.

checkout.description: Checkout the new branch immediately (default true)

name: local_git_merge
description: Merge a branch into the current branch. Optionally create a merge commit (no fast-forward).

name: local_git_stash
description: Stash current working changes to save them temporarily without committing.

name: local_git_stash_pop
description: Apply the latest (or a specific) stash and remove it from the stash list.

index.description: Stash index to pop (default 0 = most recent)

name: local_git_reset
description: Reset HEAD to a target commit (soft/mixed/hard) or unstage a specific file.

mode.description: soft (keep changes), mixed (unstage), or hard (discard changes)

name: local_git_remote
description: List all remotes for a git repository with their fetch and push URLs.

name: local_git_clone
description: Clone a git repository to the local machine.

name: local_git_tag
description: List existing git tags or create a new tag (optionally annotated with a message).

name: local_git_blame
description: Show who last modified each line of a file and in which commit.

name: local_npm_run
description: Run an npm script defined in package.json in a project directory.

script.description: Script name from package.json scripts (e.g. build, test, dev)

name: local_npm_install
description: Run npm install in a project directory, optionally installing a specific package.

package.description: Specific package to install (omit for npm install)

name: local_npm_list
description: List installed npm packages in a project directory at the top level.

name: local_get_package_json
description: Read and parse package.json from a project directory, returning name, version, scripts, and dependency lists.

name: local_project_overview
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a complete snapshot of a project — directory structure, git status, recent commits, package.json summary, and .env key list — all in one call.

name: local_git_smart_commit
description: SUPER TOOL: Stage all changes, create a commit, and optionally push — the three most common git steps in one command.

push.description: Also push to remote after committing (default false)

add_pattern.description: What to stage: -A (all), . (current dir), or specific path

name: local_scaffold_file
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a new file from a named template (react-component, api-route, test, prisma-model, middleware, env-example) with variable substitution.

template.description: Template name: react-component, api-route, test, prisma-model, middleware, env-example

variables.description: Key-value pairs for {{variable}} substitution in templates

name: local_docker_list_containers
description: List running Docker containers (or all with all=true).

name: local_docker_start
description: Start a stopped Docker container.

name: local_docker_stop
description: Stop a running Docker container.

name: local_docker_restart
description: Restart a Docker container.

name: local_docker_logs
description: Get the tail of a Docker container's logs.

name: local_docker_exec
description: Execute a command inside a running Docker container.

name: local_docker_list_images
description: List Docker images on the local system.

name: local_docker_pull
description: Pull a Docker image from a registry.

name: local_docker_compose_up
description: Run docker compose up to start services defined in a compose file.

name: local_docker_compose_down
description: Run docker compose down to stop and remove containers.

name: local_docker_compose_logs
description: Get logs from docker compose services.

name: local_kill_process
description: Send a signal to a process by PID (default TERM — graceful shutdown).

signal.description: Signal name: TERM, KILL, HUP, INT

name: local_get_process_by_name
description: Find running processes by name or command pattern.

name: local_get_memory_usage
description: Read OS system memory counters in bytes: total, free and used (total minus free, including caches).

name: local_get_cpu_usage
description: Sample aggregate OS CPU busy/idle percentages over an interval; not process usage or container entitlement.

name: local_zip_files
description: Create a ZIP archive from a list of files or directories.

name: local_unzip
description: Extract a ZIP archive to a directory.

name: local_tar_create
description: Create a tar archive (optionally gzip-compressed) from files or directories.

name: local_tar_extract
description: Extract a tar archive to a directory.

name: local_ping
description: Ping a host to check network connectivity and measure latency.

name: local_curl
description: Make an HTTP request using curl and return the response body and status code.

name: local_check_ports
description: Check whether specific ports are open on a host.

name: local_systemctl_status
description: Get the status of a systemd service.

name: local_systemctl_restart
description: Restart a systemd service using sudo.

name: local_systemctl_logs
description: Get journalctl logs for a systemd service.
